import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
import numpy as np

# Read and group the CSV values for London by date.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
london = (df[df['city'] == 'London']
          .groupby('date', as_index=False)['temp_c'].mean()
          .sort_values('date'))

x = mdates.date2num(london['date'])
y = london['temp_c'].to_numpy()
trend = np.polyval(np.polyfit(x, y, 1), x)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.plot(london['date'], y, marker='o', label="London temp_c")
ax.plot(london['date'], trend, linestyle='--', label='Linear trend')
ax.set_xlabel('Date')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_title("London Temperature Over Time with Linear Trend")
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y-%m-%d'))
fig.autofmt_xdate()
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
